#### Problem description

The above is a simplified version of the example in [this comment](https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/15457#issuecomment-394124844) - and both of them used to work (I tested in ``0.19.0+git14-ga40e185``, @jolespin tested in ``0.22``). Creating this separate issue because #15457 itself is _not_ a regression.

Notice the error changes if you replace ``param_index.keys()`` with ``list(param_index.keys())`` (but stays the same if you just replace the ``OrderedDict`` with an ordinary ``dict``).

#### Expected Output
